title: Follow Up Questions

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: You're the one from the other day. The sermon that never happened.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're the one from the other day. The sermon that never happened.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I am.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: It's nice to see you again. We didn't get to talk as much as I would have liked.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's nice to see you again. We didn't get to talk as much as I would have liked.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Tell me about yourself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tell me about yourself.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Tell me about the Church of the Binary God.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tell me about the Church of the Binary God.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Tell me about the Church of the Binary God.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Tell me about the Church of the Binary God.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Tell me about the sermons.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tell me about the sermons.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: Would if I could. Only the coders know the sermon before it's given. It's what makes them who they are. Their ability to read and speak the language.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Would if I could. Only the coders know the sermon before it's given. It's what makes them who they are. Their ability to read and speak the language.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: It's... sacred. It teaches the scripture of ones and zeros. Of finding a path in life through simplicity.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's... sacred. It teaches the scripture of ones and zeros. Of finding a path in life through simplicity.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And you really believe that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you really believe that?

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: Me? What, um, what about me? I have a pretty basic life. The scripture of ones and zeros has helped me find happiness and fulfillment in the little things.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Me? What, um, what about me? I have a pretty basic life. The scripture of ones and zeros has helped me find happiness and fulfillment in the little things.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: I do!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I do!

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: I do...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I do...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You don't sound too sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't sound too sure.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Always?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Always?

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: Well... Yes. I mean...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well... Yes. I mean...

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: It's hard sometimes. I mean... wow, I can't believe I'm saying this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's hard sometimes. I mean... wow, I can't believe I'm saying this.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's okay. Keep going.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's okay. Keep going.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You probably shouldn't.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You probably shouldn't.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: It's not just one thing though. Lately it's... well, look at whats been happening in the city. Killers? District lock downs and broken Comms?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's not just one thing though. Lately it's... well, look at whats been happening in the city. Killers? District lock downs and broken Comms?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And those things make you question?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And those things make you question?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And those things make you question?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And those things make you question?

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: By themselves? No. Collectively? Maybe? And then, on top of it all, one of my closest friends loses her sister to a drug overdose.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: By themselves? No. Collectively? Maybe? And then, on top of it all, one of my closest friends loses her sister to a drug overdose.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Did you try to help her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did you try to help her?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Did you try to help her?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Did you try to help her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's not on you though.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's not on you though.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: It doesn't matter. If you truly believe in the ones and zeros, this is a zero. You accept. You mourn. You look for the ones.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It doesn't matter. If you truly believe in the ones and zeros, this is a zero. You accept. You mourn. You look for the ones.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So what are the ones?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what are the ones?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How long are you allowed to mourn?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How long are you allowed to mourn?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How long are you allowed to mourn?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How long are you allowed to mourn?

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: There's no limit or rule or anything. I'll probably be mourning Tehani for the rest of my life. I can't even imagine how Sky is doing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's no limit or rule or anything. I'll probably be mourning Tehani for the rest of my life. I can't even imagine how Sky is doing.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: I mean Sky's still here. I'm still here. Tehani had a good life while she was here. Always happy and just looking to have fun. I can't even imagine how Sky is doing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean Sky's still here. I'm still here. Tehani had a good life while she was here. Always happy and just looking to have fun. I can't even imagine how Sky is doing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: When was the last time you talked to her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When was the last time you talked to her?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: When was the last time you talked to her?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: When was the last time you talked to her?

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: It's been too long. She was so closed off the last few times I tried. I just hope she hasn't gone away. Express flight to Luna or something. I don't know if I could lose her too, you know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's been too long. She was so closed off the last few times I tried. I just hope she hasn't gone away. Express flight to Luna or something. I don't know if I could lose her too, you know?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: She's supposed to let me know when Tehani's marker is in the Holocropolis. It's been a few weeks but you know how anything with the city goes. Permit this. Proof of that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She's supposed to let me know when Tehani's marker is in the Holocropolis. It's been a few weeks but you know how anything with the city goes. Permit this. Proof of that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you want me to check on her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you want me to check on her?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you want me to check on her?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you want me to check on her?

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: Why? What's in it for you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why? What's in it for you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just trying to be a one in someone's life.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just trying to be a one in someone's life.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Just trying to be a one in someone's life.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Just trying to be a one in someone's life.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Give you time to accept the zeros. Maybe realize this is just life.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Give you time to accept the zeros. Maybe realize this is just life.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Give you time to accept the zeros. Maybe realize this is just life.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Give you time to accept the zeros. Maybe realize this is just life.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: Oh... Okay. Sure. She, um, she works at this bar, Wireless Connection.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh... Okay. Sure. She, um, she works at this bar, Wireless Connection.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She's going to do what she needs to.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She's going to do what she needs to.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She's going to do what she needs to.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She's going to do what she needs to.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Never heard of it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never heard of it.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: It's in the Space Port. Hence the Luna thought. If she's there, tell her I miss her and I'll be there soon... I just need to figure some things out first.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's in the Space Port. Hence the Luna thought. If she's there, tell her I miss her and I'll be there soon... I just need to figure some things out first.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You will. Faith is a powerful thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You will. Faith is a powerful thing.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You will. Faith is a powerful thing.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You will. Faith is a powerful thing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You will. Faith isn't everything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You will. Faith isn't everything.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: Mhmmmm.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mhmmmm.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: Tax and tariff the air you breath while filing out the forms. Gah! It's all so fucked! No. I need to focus on the ones. There are always ones.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tax and tariff the air you breath while filing out the forms. Gah! It's all so fucked! No. I need to focus on the ones. There are always ones.

nodes.speaker: Magz Zunica
nodes.text: And yet we just keep on going, all of us acting like we're fine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And yet we just keep on going, all of us acting like we're fine.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Welcome to Nivalis.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Welcome to Nivalis.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: True, it's been tough recently.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: True, it's been tough recently.
